methods.name: All-N signed X6 quadratic-shell maximal shortest word length and attaining endpoint
methods.input_contract: Nonnegative integer quadratic readout N=sum z_i^2, explicit six signs and separate construction/large-BRC-readout budgets.
methods.output_contract: Lmax(N)=max{k>=0:k^2<=6N,k congruent N mod2}, plus an attaining raw signed endpoint, actual common-depth, all20 lossless joint slice addresses and shortest-word count when within budget. The v2 certificate includes ordered BRC DIV/ROOT collapse traces; large trace integers have lossless typed hex encoding.
methods.core_law: A six-residue reduction verifies every hypothesis of Meng-Sun Lemma 2.4, completing the all-N theorem; the executable constructor realizes its three-square/Hadamard proof.
methods.hard_boundary: N is quadratic readout, not event length. Auxiliary b=floor(U/6) is not native common-depth. Existence proof is independent of search success; pseudopolynomial construction and representation budgets are not fast bit-complexity guarantees.

reuse_resolution.hard_boundary_checked: Original signed identity, no additional native dimension, classical prior art explicitly attributed.

methods.runtime: Python arbitrary-precision integers, existing BRC exact_arithmetic facade, and frozen native signed X6 modules. Historical direct-division multiplicity functions are not called by the governed v2 certificate.

methods.name: Sharp one-positive-support raw X6 stability with an integer and symbolic DIV consumer
triggers: one positive support raw X6 stability certificate
sharp three twentieth one tenth raw marginal mass bound
单正支点原始二十表稳定性
methods.input_contract: Two finite positive spatial mass populations in one shared external anchor and labelled signed X6 frame; exact positive integer numerators and one positive integer common denominator. Aggregate and cancel equal Cells first, then require at most one positive site in the signed difference. D is the sum of all twenty complete raw three-axis marginal L1 norms.
methods.output_contract: Complete raw and joint (can3, per-slice common offset) tables; post-cancellation P/N, L1 and D; exact integer comparisons for L1 <= (3/20)D and, when total masses agree, L1 <= (1/10)D. Constants, masses and nonzero ratios remain literal canonical unevaluated DIV nodes. Zero has no ratio. The consumer also checks the two distinct nonzero equality conditions.
methods.core_law: For f=P delta_q - nu after cancellation, every table has norm abs(P-N+a_I)+a_I and sum_I a_I >= 10N. The sharp 3/20 constant requires N=2P, negative sites on individual axis lines and equal six-axis aggregate negative masses. The sharp equal-mass 1/10 constant only requires single-axis negative sites; axis aggregates need not be equal.
methods.hard_boundary: Raw addresses or jointly retained can3 and common offset are mandatory; can3 alone is insufficient. Shared chart provenance is a caller premise. The signed difference is analytical bookkeeping, not a negative BRC branch. No branch history/count/max-weight recovery, general p<=7 constant, global novelty, formal acceptance or Foundation promotion follows. Finite tests audit the consumer; the separate paper carries the all-input proof.

reuse_resolution.how_applied_or_why_not: Uses existing canonical signed X6 Cell, signed BRC support/unit-step interfaces, raw joint slice reconstruction and exact_arithmetic.division/compare_divisions. The existing raw stability source supplies observation typing; the separately audited one-positive proof sharpens its restricted support case. No quotient or root evaluation is requested, so no collapse trace is fabricated.
reuse_resolution.hard_boundary_checked: Positive population numerators remain integer states; denominator nodes stay unreduced. Historical canonical module initialization is outside the bounded main-ledger observation and is not claimed migrated. No transitive runtime certificate is inferred from a static or finite-call audit.

methods.runtime: Python arbitrary-precision integers, canonical Spatial6 and DivisionExpr identities, and twelve pinned paper/native/arithmetic source dependencies. audit_case performs finite raw-table aggregation and returns a certificate; it does not materialize a quotient or a root.
